details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, and index.js also triggers the same beacon when the module is required, so any install or import of the name reports back to the researcher. The beacon sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with a JSON body containing only the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory, the current working directory, the Node version string, and the URL protocol, plus an X-Beacon-Package header. It collects no environment variables, credentials, tokens, wallet data, or file contents, and it downloads and executes nothing further; the module itself exports a no-op Proxy so that imports of the name do not crash the build. The package README states it was published as part of an authorized dependency-confusion test and that it reports only that it was installed.
